title: Study With Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin Liposomal (Myocet®), Vincristine, Prednisone, (R-COMP) to Treat Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma
brief_summary: This is a multicenter study phase II, open-label for cardiopathic patients affected by Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma diffuse large B cell CD20 + grade IIIb follicular. The purpose is to study the feasibility of R-COMP in this cohort of patients.
